# Embedding

A vector representation of an information object (usually a core gmeow:Chunk), produced by an embedding model — the genuine vocabulary gap in the semantic-web stack (#54): model, dimensionality, and metric have no agreed RDF representation, so the refusal is recorded in the alignment trailer rather than papered over. The vector payload stays OUTSIDE the graph (gmeow:vectorRef, P12); the graph carries the provenance that makes it auditable.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Embedding>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:Embedding`  

**Subclass of:** `gmeow:InformationObject`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/graphrag>
